scripts.build: pnpm --filter @templatical/types run build && pnpm --filter @templatical/core --filter @templatical/renderer --filter @templatical/import-beefree --filter @templatical/import-unlayer --filter @templatical/import-html --filter @templatical/import-mjml --filter @templatical/import-topol --filter @templatical/import-stripo --filter @templatical/import-chamaileon --filter @templatical/import-easy-email-pro run build && pnpm --filter @templatical/media-library run build:all && pnpm --filter @templatical/quality run build && pnpm --filter @templatical/template-tools run build && pnpm --filter @templatical/editor run build:all
scripts.build:all-sdk: pnpm run build:email-editor && pnpm run build:media-library
scripts.changeset:version: changeset version && pnpm --filter @templatical/template-tools run sync-pins && pnpm --filter @templatical/docs run build:changelog && pnpm --filter @templatical/docs run build:agent-surface
scripts.ci: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: eslint packages/*/src apps/*/src packages/*/tests apps/*/tests apps/*/e2e packages/*/scripts skills/*/tests --max-warnings 0 --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run typecheck && pnpm --filter @templatical/playground run typecheck
